title: Tapas? Yes please!
text: I loved going to the market. Even though it was hot, it was a great experience. Our guide was so nice and she’s so sweet. I love the chef. He has such a great and vibrant personality. Very knowledgeable. I learned a lot. I loved it! I would do it again and again.
author: Roger_T

title: Worth it, do it, awesome time
text: Totally and completely worth it. We had a blast. Who else can say they cook authentic Spanish cuisine in an almost 500 year old building and that it could be so much fun.
author: Juan_S

title: Chef had my Husband volunteering to cook!
text:
Our Barcelona high light! Chef Alfredo was such a character and truely passionate about Spanish/ Catalan food, culture and cooking. He even had my Husband volunteering to cook!  If you want a relaxing, yet easy way to learn about Barcelona and cooking we rate this experience sublime and deliciously entertaining.
The best Brulee I have ever had! Don't tell Francois. Gracie xx
author: Sally_H

title: Great Catalan experience.
text: Chef Alfredo was great — very knowledgeable and fun!  The food was excellent and we enjoyed participating.  We learned a lot.
author: Anne_F
